name: Card / chargeback fraud
description: Stolen cards used for purchase; legitimate customer disputes leading to chargeback liability.

name: Friendly fraud (item-not-received)
description: Customer claims goods not received and disputes payment.

name: Marketplace seller fraud / counterfeit
description: Marketplace seller lists counterfeit / non-existent goods; takes payment; disappears.

name: Customer-data breach (GDPR)
description: Customer database exposed via injection / sub-processor breach / lost device.

name: Delivery to sanctioned jurisdiction / party
description: Order ships to a sanctioned address or buyer / UBO matches sanctions list.
